messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> service=redwood-inference-eu-west-1-gpu-pool severity=high
incident-bot: symptom=5xx spike (request failures), metric=serve_errors count=120 in 1m, threshold=20
incident-bot: link=https://pagerduty.local/incidents/PD-2026-12345 runbook=https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/az-outage-fallback

Maria: acked the PD alert and joining. oncall here, paging Ajay.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-2026-12345 acknowledged by Maria (Oncall). Escalation paused.

Ajay: looking at metrics — az3 in eu-west-1 showing node OOMs and 503s from the serving cluster. logs:
```
[2026-03-14T10:12:17Z] serve: node-az3-17 - kvcache miss - OOM on alloc (cuda)
[2026-03-14T10:12:19Z] http: 503 POST /v1/generate model=redwood-bison size=10240
[2026-03-14T10:12:21Z] infra: gpu-host-17 gpu_util=98% swap-increasing
```

Linh: confirmed — network egress to AZ3 spiking, also seeing degraded kernel launches. Likely localized AZ3 hardware/host-level instability.

Ben: CS reports 3 paying customers seeing timeouts and elevated latencies (~8-12s) for embeddings and chat in EU. 

Eve: any autoscaler events? did we spin new nodes?

ops-bot: Autoscaler attempted 3 scale-ups at 10:12:30Z but failed: quota_exceeded (gpu-quota-eu-west-1). Details: https://infra.redwood/ops/alerts/5678

Ajay: quota issue explains failed recovery. Plan: (1) activate region fallback for non-SLA traffic, (2) drain and cordon nodes in az3, (3) open support ticket with cloud provider for az3.

Maria: do we have an approved quick-failover play? I can authorize. Need rollback criteria too.

Linh: I'm going to start a staged failover — route 20% of inference requests to eu-west-2 first (canary), non-critical customers only. command: 
```
# enable failover route
infra route update --from-region eu-west-1 --to-region eu-west-2 --percent 20 --selector "!tag:sla_premium" --reason "az3 instability"
```

ops-bot: Running command: infra route update ...
ops-bot: Success. Canary at 20% initiated.

Ben: I'll notify affected customers (CS) and mark monitors. Adding temporary SLA exception for impacted customers.

Ajay: watching error rate. If 20% canary is stable for 5m, we'll ramp to 60%, then 100% for non-premium. If anything spikes, immediate rollback.

15m later...

Ajay: Canary stable: EU error rate dropped from 18% -> 4% for routed traffic. Proceeding to 60% now.

ops-bot: infra route update -> percent 60 applied.

incident-bot: Escalation timer: auto-escalate to SRE manager in 10m if not resolved.

Maria: I'm handing off to Linh for mitigation and follow-up. I need to step off for another call. Handoff notes: runbook followed, PD acknowledged, canary stable, customers notified.

Linh: Taking over. Will continue the ramp and engage cloud provider. Assigning postmortem owner = Ajay.

pagerduty-bot: PD-2026-12345 status=investigating -> status=monitoring (mitigation in progress).

ops-bot: Cloud provider ticket created: CP-78910 (AZ3 reported degraded hardware). ETA initial response 30-45m.

Ben: CS updated customers and provided workaround (point to eu-west-2 endpoint) for urgent workloads.

Eve: reminder to update incident channel with any config changes (DNS, route updates) — we need traceability for postmortem.

Linh: noted. current actions: continue ramp to 100% non-premium, monitor latencies, cordon az3 nodes, open replacement ops for gpu-host-17.

Ajay: tentative timeline: mitigation complete (traffic stable on eu-west-2) in ~30-45m, deeper remediation after cloud provider confirms hardware replacement.

incident-bot: Incident thread will remain open until PD cleared. Please add any commands executed to the runbook page.

Maria: thanks team. I'll re-check at 11:30Z for handoff to night-oncall.

Linh: will post a summary and ops commands run when we hit 100% traffic.

-- end of thread --
